title: Hang-Ups
description: Everybody has their hang ups. Anticipating a date at his overly messy apartment, a man frantically cleans and rearranges everything in sight — and unravels when his date doesn't show by 7:00, in a montage cut entirely to John Waters and Divine's "Female Trouble." A companion piece to DEFICIT, shot the same scrappy way: Willett writing, directing, and starring, Zendejas as DP, editor, and colorist, all on a budget under $200 — together, the two shorts are what got Jacob into SDSU's film production program.
